Bat wings are dropped by bats which appear at night in few outside areas as well as inside the dungeon. Bat wings can be used to craft [[pigskin paper]] or for [[alchemy]].

==Alchemy==

Bat wings can be decomposed to [[chaos powder|powder]] and [[Chaos solution|solution]] with the [[alchemy mill]] and [[hand mixer]], respectively. Having unlocked [[Anatomy and Alchemy (Tech Tree)|Master of Alchemy]] produces one additional reagent at any workstation.
